title: docs(ci): point the four required-set sentences at the gate that reads the ruleset
body:
Fixes #9502

Four sentences in the tree told an author that the merge queue's required-check set cannot be read
from this repository, and that the four `Test (shard N/4)` contexts are not in it. All four were
**true when written** and are false today. This repairs the prose by pointing at the instrument that
takes the reading, rather than restating an answer that can go stale again.

## The population, re-derived on this base, and the control

`git grep` over `origin/main` @ `3adc50eec8` for both phrase families. **Independent claims — 4
lines in 3 files:**

| file | the claim |
|:--|:--|
| `scripts/dependabot-merge-gate.mjs` | "can neither read nor change" / "demonstrably not carrying the shards today" |
| `content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md` (Merge Queue, step 3) | "nothing here can read the current state of it either" |
| `content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md` (Dependabot Auto-Merge bullet) | "a repository-settings surface nothing here can read" / "provably does not contain the shards today" |
| `.github/workflows/dependabot-auto-merge.yml` (header) | "a repository-SETTINGS surface nothing here can read or change" / "provably does not contain the shards today" |

**Quotations kept consistent:** the Required Check Set Patrol paragraph on the CI/CD page, which
quoted step 3 verbatim, and the inventory docblock in `scripts/check-required-check-set.mjs`, which
named the carriers.

**CONTROL, same command, one argument changed:** the identical `git grep -n -i` for
`zzz-no-such-phrase-9502` returns **0 files, exit 1**, while the phrase greps return the rows above.
The zeros reported below are readings, not a grep that matches nothing.

## Why they are false, measured, with a firing control

`GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectui/rules/branches/main` answers **HTTP 200** with a
`required_status_checks` rule carrying nine contexts, all four `Test (shard N/4)` among them, and
`strict_required_status_checks_policy: true`.

**CONTROL, same command, same token, one argument changed:** `GET
/rules/branches/zzz-no-such-branch-9502` answers **`200 []`**. The reader distinguishes "a branch
with rules" from "a branch with none", so the non-empty answer is a reading and not a default.

Ruleset `11776024`: `enforcement: active`, `source_type: Repository`, **`updated_at`
2026-08-24** — after objectui#4959 (2026-08-17), the measurement the sentences were derived from.
The world changed and the prose did not.

## The write half is still true, so the sentences are split, not deleted

A prior author considered these sentences and left them standing deliberately —
`scripts/check-required-check-set.mjs` states that the write half of all three is still true and
that the file does not touch it. That argument holds and is re-measured here: `GET
/repos/objectstack-ai/objectui/branches/main/protection` answers **403 `Resource not accessible by
integration`**. Only a maintainer edits the ruleset.

So each carrier now says both true things separately: the surface **cannot be written** from here,
and the current state **can be read** — by `pnpm check:required-check-set`
(`scripts/check-required-check-set.mjs`, exit 2 when the reading could not be taken, never a pass;
exit 3 on breach), patrolled daily by `.github/workflows/required-check-set-patrol.yml`. No repaired
sentence restates the membership.

The gate's own rationale was re-based at the same time. It used to rest on "the required set does
not carry the shards", which a ruleset edit falsified. It now rests on two things no ruleset edit
can move: the declaration in `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS` is **broader** than any required set has been, and
it is visible to review and to a partition test, which off-repo configuration is not. **No gate
changed behaviour** — `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS`, `OPTIONAL_CONTEXTS`, `NOT_A_GATE`, `PINNED_CONTEXTS` and
`WATCHED_CONTEXTS` are byte-identical.

## One extra sentence disambiguated, in the same file and family

The "May this context be required?" bullet (same page, ~20 lines below step 3) said that question is
a property of settings "no test here can read". That is **still true** — it is the normative
question, and no test in a checkout has network — but read next to the repaired step 3 it now
scans as a contradiction. It is reworded to separate *are* required (observable, and the patrol
observes it) from *ought to be* required (a human's answer in `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS`). No claim was
reversed.

## Out of scope, deliberately

`AGENTS.md` carries a fourth instance. It is **governed surface** and is not in this diff. It is
also not obviously false on the same terms: its parenthetical covers who may **bypass** the ruleset
as well as the required-context list, and bypass actors are not carried by the endpoint this gate
reads. That is recorded in the gate's inventory docblock as deliberately left standing, with the
reason. **Ruling on it is a separate, governed decision and is not made here.**

The ruleset itself is untouched. The four `Test (shard N/4)` jobs and `.github/workflows/ci.yml` are
untouched — that is objectui#9499 and is not addressed in this pull request.

## Tests

The repair is pinned so it cannot rot the same way, in
`scripts/__tests__/check-required-check-set.test.ts`: each of the three repaired files must make no
"cannot be read" claim, must name the gate, and must not restate the ruleset's membership — each
assertion anchored first, so a moved or emptied file cannot pass it vacuously.

**Ablation, on the committed tree.** The repaired claim was re-inserted into
`.github/workflows/dependabot-auto-merge.yml`, verbatim from `origin/main`. On-disk proof before
reading the result: injected-text hits `1` (want 1), removed-text hits `0` (want 0), pre-mutation
anchor hits `1` (want 1). The suite then went **red on exactly the right test** — `1 failed | 27
passed`, the failure being `.github/workflows/dependabot-auto-merge.yml makes no "cannot be read"
claim`. Restored under an `EXIT INT TERM` trap via `git checkout HEAD --`, verified by blob hash
equality against `HEAD` (`61c4daf057…`), not by an exit code.

**Anchor probe.** The two new in-page anchors are proven by the same method: replacing one with
`#zzz-no-such-anchor-9502` makes `pnpm docs:check-links` exit **1** and name it, so the clean run is
a reading. Restored and hash-verified.

The control leg of the new block has a self-contained half, so its zeros do not depend on the
governed carrier staying as it is: the detector is first proven able to return non-zero on a
constructed sentence and to stay zero on the repaired spelling.

**Commands run, exit codes captured before any pipe:**

| command | exit |
|:--|:--|
| `pnpm check:required-check-set` | 0 — 32 cases pass |
| `vitest run --project unit` over the 3 pinning tests + the ledger test | 0 — 170 passed |
| `vitest run --project unit scripts/__tests__` (whole directory, 160 files) | 0 — 4654 passed, 2 skipped |
| `pnpm docs:check-links` | 0 — valid across 17 scan roots |
| `pnpm check:control-bytes` | 0 — 7692 tracked text files |
| `pnpm check:doc-fences` · `check:doc-types` · `check:doc-example-ids` | 0 |
| `pnpm check:action-ref-convention` · `check:changeset-claims` | 0 |
| `pnpm check:new-line-citations` | 0 — 0 new citations |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` | 0 |
| `pnpm type-check:scripts` | 0 |
| `pnpm lint:root` | 0 errors (32 pre-existing warnings, none in changed files) |

`pnpm check:doc-snippets` exits **2 = PREREQUISITE NOT MET** here (it needs a scoped package build
that is not present in this worktree). That is **NOT MEASURED**, not a pass and not a failure; this
diff adds and changes no fenced code block in the document, and CI builds before running it.

## Non-comment / non-prose lines moved, per file

Measured against the base, comments and markdown classified out:

| file | code added | code removed |
|:--|--:|--:|
| `scripts/dependabot-merge-gate.mjs` | **0** | **0** |
| `content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md` | **0** | **0** |
| `.github/workflows/dependabot-auto-merge.yml` | **0** | **0** |
| `scripts/check-required-check-set.mjs` | **0** | **0** |
| `.changeset/9502-required-set-readable-pointers.md` | **0** | **0** |
| `scripts/__tests__/check-required-check-set.test.ts` | 46 | 0 |
| `scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs` | 6 | 0 |

Every carrier moved **zero** executable lines in both directions. The only code is the new pin and
its ledger entry.

## Changeset

`.changeset/9502-required-set-readable-pointers.md`, **empty frontmatter** — nothing published moves
(`check-changeset-presence.mjs` reads 0 published sources and 0 moved manifests in this range).

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么** — 仓内四句话告诉作者「合并队列的 required checks 清单在仓里读不到」,并且「四个
`Test (shard N/4)` 不在清单里」。这四句现在改成:写入那一半仍然读不到(protection 端点对
Actions token 答 403,只有维护者能改 ruleset),读取那一半**指向**已有的探针
`pnpm check:required-check-set`,不再把答案抄进散文。

**为什么改** — 四句话写下时全部为真(objectui#4959 实测到四个 shard 还在 `in_progress` 时就合并了,
只有它们不是 required 才可能)。ruleset 的 `updated_at` 是 2026-08-24,在那次实测之后。世界变了,
散文没变。信这四句话去重命名或重新分片测试 job 的作者,会让**全仓每一个 PR** 永久卡在四个再也
产不出来的 context 上,而且只有维护者能改回来。

**风险与代价(含回滚)** — 没有任何 gate 的行为改变,`REQUIRED_CONTEXTS` 等五张清单逐字节未动;
可执行代码只加在测试侧。新增的 pin 里有一条腿读 `AGENTS.md`(受管面,本 PR 未改):将来若有人裁决
并修掉那句话,这条腿会红,失败信息直接写明补救办法是把探针的 inventory docblock 一起挪,不是削弱
检测器。回滚 = revert 两个 commit,不影响任何已发布产物。

**席位意见** — (留空,由席位定稿)

**你要做的** — 两件事需要维护者裁决,本 PR 都没有代做:① `AGENTS.md` 里第四处(`从仓内读不到`)
是否也要修 —— 它的括号里还包含「谁可绕过」,而本 PR 用的端点不携带 bypass actors,所以它可能在一条
其余三处没有的腿上仍然为真。② objectui#9499(重命名/重新分片 shard job)现在可以安全执行了,因为
误导它的四句话已经修掉。
